document.about: PLoS ONE 2012, Face and Aggression. Page 5 sets a figure's caption across both columns, six lines deep, over eight rows of two-column text and a table.

checks.issue: #436: counted line by line, the caption's six lines across the gutter were more than a region that size may have, so no gutter was found and the columns under it were read line by line across it.
checks.text: Both masculinity (p,0.0001) and attractiveness ratings (p = 0.04) also were significant predictors.
The face ratio remained a significant predictor (beta value = .56, t = 3.219, p = 0.002) with the addition of the additional predictors and their interactions.
